validation.strictClockLexicalGateC327: Only a verified numeric Activity with required route, four strict-valid HHMM(+1) clocks and actual printed Blk Hrs may reach detached flight-candidate staging. Range check hour<24/minute<60; preserve per-cell +1. Nonflight must be excluded before strict clock validation: 22/22 nonnumeric bands have four clock-position text objects but only 17/22 have four valid clocks, and two nonnumeric route+valid-base intervals are plausible 65/237 minutes. Never synthesize Block from nonflight elapsed clocks.
validation.timeArithmeticScopeC327: Numeric base elapsed equals printed Block 26/26, local equals only 16/26 in this private original; equality is layout-specific validation not semantic Block equivalence, operational proof or timezone authority.
validation.durationNormalizationC328: For this validated PDC report family, accept strict H:MM and HH:MM as duration lexemes with 00–59 minutes; preserve original raw string, compare typed minutes only. Do not apply +1 clock-day suffix to Blk Hrs, infer Block from nonflight clocks, or equate printed Blk Hrs to canonical company Block. Exact two date-qualified company candidates are 2/2 minute-equal but 0/2 raw-string equal due to width.
validation.pairingPresenceC328: All 13 own-Date numeric rows have Pairing text, but 3 of 13 undated numeric rows also have Pairing; 6 nonnumeric Activity rows also have Pairing. Pairing presence is neither an own-Date surrogate nor a flight classifier, and its absence does not authorize forward-fill. Keep own-Date cell presence and Activity classification separate.
validation.checkInOutAndRolloverC329: Per-cell raw +1: four numeric STA(L/B)+1 and C/O(L)+1, one numeric STD(B)+1; four nonflight STA(L/B)+1. Never assume arrival-only, flight-only or day correction.
